profile.headline: Follower of Jesus, Husband, and Dad.  Computer Software Specialist II at MLGW.  Founder of Ground Software.
profile.summary:
Currently employed as a Computer Software Specialist II at Memphis Light, Gas, and Water.
Founder of Ground Software.

positions.title: Founder / Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Oversee all aspects of software development and company operations, including managing independent contractors, architecting scalable development environments, and driving the vision and technical direction of Ground Software’s products and services.

positions.title: Computer Software Specialist II
positions.description: I am on the development team for the My Account customer portal.  We service hundreds of thousands of Memphis residents and customers through web and mobile applications.
positions.insights: Full-Stack Development, Mobile Applications and +4 skills

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description: Information Services managing school applications (Canvas, SONIS, Moodle, Office365, Quicklaunch, EBSCO), servers, workstations, networking, classroom technology, and end-user support.
positions.insights: Network Security, Computer Information Systems and +3 skills

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description: Developing the UMRF Ventures landing page from scratch using PHP, HTML, CSS and JavaScript
positions.insights: JavaScript, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +8 skills

positions.title: Level 2 - FedEx IT Help Desk
positions.description: My role required the troubleshooting of FedEx software and hardware related issues.
